name: Angels of New Capenna
description: Angels who defend New Capenna and then fly through portals to protect the Multiverse.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In the cathedral Elspeth and Giada hear the angels' statues sing; Giada says it is her family and that she is home, and Elspeth realizes home is purpose.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Invasion Tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals.
timeline.quote: "The angels are being unleashed into the Multiverse, bringing the power of Halo with them."

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a corrupted angel, cuts through New Capenna's defenses while the angels, demons and devils fight her armies.
timeline.quote: She cuts her way through the city's defenses as a farmer threshing wheat.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The tower of New Capenna collapses on Atraxa and kills her.
timeline.quote: it is the city itself. The gleaming glass and steel tower of New Capenna collapses atop her

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: With Atraxa dead, the Invasion Tree's barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
timeline.quote: Atraxa's death has changed New Phyrexia

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
timeline.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Giada leads the angels' charge across the Multiverse and speaks with Elspeth on New Phyrexia, promising help.
timeline.quote: That's just what I wanted to tell you. Some of us are coming to help.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The demons betray the angels after New Capenna's completion, trapping them in stasis to convert their bodies into Halo.
timeline.quote: after its completion the demons betrayed the angels, trapping them in a kind of stasis

citation.text: "Halo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
